text:
zoe_support: AcuityLabs raised a ticket — they saw burst charges on 07/01 even though their 8-node reserved commit was up for renewal that day. Can finance/ops triage before I reply?

mike_fin: Please paste the invoice snippet and the reserved pool id so I can start a reconciliation.

zoe_support: Ticket AL-9933, invoice INV-2026-0701. Pool id: acuity-res-8. Billing snippet from ticket:
```
Invoice: INV-2026-0701
Period: 2026-07-01 to 2026-07-31
 - Reserved capacity (acuity-res-8): 8 nodes - $16,000
 - Burst usage (burst-unallocated): 10 node-hours on 07/01 - $150
Total: $16,150
```

billing-bot: Meter export attached (acuity_meter_2026_07_01.csv).

ashley_sales: Acuity is strategic; keep the reply proactive. If it's our renewal flow that caused the gap, we'll want to consider a goodwill credit and a clear note.

raj_ops: Quick look at activation logs: renewal transaction completed but the billing effective timestamp was delayed by ~7 hours because their payment method update triggered a manual verification hold. Our billing pipeline treats the commit as active only after the effective timestamp, so any usage before that is marked burst. The nodes were running the whole time; this is a timing window issue between payment/auth flow and meter activation.

sam_engineering: Confirmed. The activation event was ingested at 15:10 UTC; customer traffic had a spike at 08:30 UTC that day. Exported rows show 10 node-hours unassigned that align with that spike. I can produce node-level CSV with node_id, ts, seen_tag for audit.

lina_revops: For audit we'll need the CSV and a backfill id if we re-associate. Also capture reason code for any credits.

mike_fin: Finance policy: we can approve manager-level credits up to $2,500 for metering/activation windows. This looks like an auth delay; propose invoice correction equal to the burst amount ($150) plus a discretionary goodwill credit of $400 given customer size and sensitivity. Total proposal $550. Need sales OK.

ashley_sales: Sales approves the $400 goodwill in addition to the invoice adjustment. We'll present it as a one-time courtesy due to a renewal timing edge-case and note the fix.

raj_ops: Ops plan: we can backfill the 10 node-hours to acuity-res-8 once finance approves. Backfill id bf-2026-908 will be run limited to 07/01 window. Also we'll add a short-term override in the billing joiner to allow a 12h pre-activation grace window for renewals when the customer has active nodes to avoid similar cases. Patch submitted and scheduled for canary.

sam_engineering: CSV attached (acuity_unassigned_07_01.csv). All rows flagged safe for re-association. Ready to run backfill when approved.

lina_revops: Revops ticket revops-944 created and attached CSV + planned backfill bf-2026-908. Documenting for audits.

mike_fin: OK I'll generate two credit memos: CM-2026-501 (invoice adj $150, reason: RENEWAL_ACTIVATION_LAG) and CM-2026-502 (service credit $400, reason: GOODWILL_RENEWAL_EXCEPTION). Routing to AP for posting to July ledger.

billing-bot: Credit memos created: CM-2026-501, CM-2026-502. Queued for posting.

zoe_support: Draft to customer: "We identified a renewal activation timing gap during your payment-method update that caused 10 node-hours to be billed as burst on 2026-07-01. We've issued a $150 invoice correction and a $400 service credit as a one-time courtesy. We've implemented a grace for same-day renewals and will backfill the affected rows. Apologies for the inconvenience." Waiting to send until AP posts credits.

mike_fin: AP posted credits to AcuityLabs account acuity-9933. Confirmed ledger posting date 2026-07-03. Finance closing.

azley_sales: Customer replied: "Thanks for taking care of this and for the explanation. The grace window is appreciated." :thumbsup:

lina_revops: Revops-944 updated: backfill bf-2026-908 completed and attachments saved. Audit trail complete.

mike_fin: Closing ticket. Good cross-team coordination. :tada:
